author: GavinNewsom

We’re hanging on by a thread. The fight to defend our democracy is far from over.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Here's a myth: you have to choose between fiscal discipline and doing big things.

California does both.

Over the past eight years, we built great things for the people of California, some of the boldest actions any government in this country has taken in a generation, and we did it without breaking the bank.

Today, I signed my final budget as Governor of California.

It’s on time, balanced, and structurally sound through June of 2028.

For the next two years, California will have a zero-dollar deficit. We're leaving the state in good hands for the next Governor.

We should be making it easier to vote, not harder.

author: GavinNewsom

Happy Juneteenth.

Today we honor the freedom, resilience, and strength of Black Americans — and the generations of civil rights leaders who marched and sacrificed so this country could live up to its own promises.

We cannot honor that legacy without speaking the truth: that freedom is under attack. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Black voters silenced at the ballot box. This is voter suppression in broad daylight.

We don't just commemorate the struggle. We CONTINUE it.

Happy Juneteenth to everyone celebrating today.
